name: The Beginning
overview: Scripture reveals that all beginnings originate with God, who created the heavens and the earth at the very start (Genesis 1:1). Though beginnings may seem small or humble, as in Job's reminder of growth from modest starts, God’s purposes lead to a hopeful and prosperous end (Job 8:7; Jeremiah 29:11). Believers are called to trust in the Lord’s strength and renewal, finding endurance and hope beyond the past (Isaiah 40:31; Isaiah 43:18), resting in His unfailing mercy and compassion that sustain us from the very beginning through every stage of life (Lamentations 3:22).
